title: Industries We Serve – Security Solutions for Every Sector | Keerthi Networks
description: Security, surveillance, networking, biometric access control and fire safety solutions for offices, homes, retail, factories, warehouses, schools, hospitals, hotels, apartments and construction sites.
lead: Every type of property has its own security and infrastructure challenges. Here is how we approach the sectors we work with — and what we typically recommend.
note: The solutions below are typical recommendations for each sector. Every property is different — we assess your site and design around what you actually need.

industries.name: Corporate Offices
challenges: Monitoring entrances, cabins and common areas
solutions: CCTV surveillance for entrances, lobbies and work areas
Biometric attendance and door access control
Structured cabling and office LAN setup
Intercom between reception, cabins and meeting rooms

industries.name: Residential & Homes
challenges: Verifying visitors before opening the door
Watching over children and elderly family members
Deterring intrusion when away or travelling
Covering gates, car ports and backyards
solutions: Video door phone at the main entrance
CCTV coverage of gates, entrances and outdoor areas
Remote mobile viewing from anywhere
Motion-activated recording for key zones
benefits: Peace of mind at home and away
Family activity visible on your phone

industries.name: Retail & Shops
challenges: Monitoring when the owner is not present
Multiple staff across counters and stores
solutions: CCTV over counters, entries and stock areas
Remote viewing for owners from anywhere
DVR/NVR storage sized for dispute resolution
Door access for stock rooms

industries.name: Manufacturing & Factories
solutions: CCTV across production floors, yards and gates
Biometric attendance with shift reporting
Fire extinguisher supply and periodic inspection
Network linking office, floor and warehouse

industries.name: Warehouses & Logistics
challenges: Large areas with valuable, fast-moving stock
solutions: Long-range and PTZ cameras for wide coverage
Night-vision CCTV for dark yards
Access control at gates and stock rooms
Networking across sheds and offices

industries.name: Schools & Institutions
solutions: CCTV at gates, corridors and common areas
Video intercom at the entrance gate
Biometric staff attendance
Fire extinguishers with inspection schedule

industries.name: Hospitals & Healthcare
solutions: CCTV in lobbies, corridors and perimeters
Access control for pharmacies and records rooms
Touchless face-recognition attendance
Reliable network for admin operations

industries.name: Hotels & Hospitality
challenges: Guest and staff movement across many areas
solutions: CCTV in lobbies, corridors, parking and kitchens
Intercom between reception and rooms/departments
Access control for stores and staff areas
Neat, professional installation

industries.name: Apartments & Gated Communities
solutions: Entrance gate CCTV with recording
Multi-flat video intercom / door phone
CCTV in parking, play areas and lobbies
Access control for gyms and common facilities

industries.name: Construction Sites
challenges: Expensive material and equipment on open sites
Theft and unauthorised entry after hours
Remote monitoring by owners and engineers
solutions: Rugged CCTV coverage of storage and work zones
Remote viewing for owners from anywhere
Biometric attendance for labour muster
Solar/power-planning advice for site conditions

industries.name: Government & Institutions
solutions: CCTV across public areas and offices
Biometric attendance for staff
Structured networking between blocks
Fire safety equipment with maintenance records

industries.name: Commercial Buildings
solutions: Common area CCTV and entrance monitoring
Building-wide intercom systems
Structured cabling backbone for tenants
Access control for lifts, lobbies and terraces
